class.name: PacketCPP
class.brief_description: Encodes and decodes the simcall wire frame exchanged with the kernel driver over TCP.
class.description: Wraps one [code]simcall_header_t[/code] (24 bytes, little-endian / native byte order, version 5) plus its variable-length data payload. Every message between the Godot host and the in-VM kernel driver is a [PacketCPP]: the header carries the command, the peripheral type, the originating process id ([code]pid[/code]), the simulation timestamp, and the payload length. Version 5 adds the [code]pid[/code] field at header offset 4 (uint32, LE): the Linux [code]tgid[/code] of the FSW process that triggered the syscall. All reply packets must echo the request's [code]pid[/code] back — the kernel logs a desync warning otherwise. [b]Inbound frame types[/b] [code]CMD_SYNCH[/code] — time seed + device registration; no data segment. [code]CMD_ACTION[/code] — peripheral I/O: dev_id + action payload. [code]CMD_PROC_HELLO[/code] — process announce: no dev_id, 16-byte NUL-padded comm name in data. [b]Decode an inbound header[/b] [codeblock] var pkt = PacketCPP.new() pkt.generate_from_bytes(first_24_bytes) # read PacketCPP.get_header_len() bytes first if not pkt.get_validity(): push_error("bad header (wrong version or size)") return HDWIResource.set_sim_time_ns(pkt.get_time_ns()) # keep the sim clock seeded var pid = pkt.get_pid() # originating FSW process var payload_len = pkt.get_data_len() # now read this many more bytes [/codeblock] [b]Build an outbound reply[/b] — always echo the request [code]pid[/code]: [codeblock] var pkt = PacketCPP.new() pkt.generate(PacketCPP.CMD_ACTION, PacketCPP.SPI, HDWIResource.get_sim_time_ns(), payload, request_pid) socket.put_data(pkt.convert_to_bytes()) [/codeblock] [b]Debugging[/b] - set [member robust] (or call [method to_string_robust]) to get a sectioned, byte-offset-labeled dump that decodes the header and interprets the data section by command type.

method.name: generate
method.description: Fills the header (version 5, [param cmd_type], [param hdwi_type], [param time_ns], [param pid]) and adopts [param bytes] as the payload. For a reply, [param pid] MUST equal the request's [code]pid[/code] (use [method get_pid] on the inbound packet). Pass [code]0[/code] for unsolicited outbound frames. Pair with [method convert_to_bytes] to get the frame to send.

method.name: generate_from_bytes
method.description: Parses exactly [method get_header_len] bytes into the header. Marks the packet valid only when the version matches 5 and the input length equals the header size; check [method get_validity] afterwards.

method.name: convert_to_bytes
method.description: Serializes header + payload into a single contiguous byte buffer ready to write to the socket.

method.name: get_validity
method.description: Whether the last [method generate_from_bytes] produced a well-formed header (correct version and length).

method.name: get_cmd_id
method.description: The command id from the header. See the [enum CmdType] constants.

method.name: get_type
method.description: The peripheral type from the header. See the [enum HDWIType] constants.

method.name: get_pid
method.description: The originating FSW process id ([code]tgid[/code]) from the header. Present on all forward-channel frames (CMD_SYNCH, CMD_ACTION, CMD_PROC_HELLO). Zero on reverse-channel events (CMD_EVENT). Echo this value in every reply that expects one — the kernel validates the lockstep.

method.name: get_time_ns
method.description: The simulation timestamp (nanoseconds) carried in the header.

method.name: get_data_len
method.description: Length in bytes of the payload that follows the header. After decoding a header, read this many more bytes from the stream to get the body.

method.name: get_header_len
method.description: Size of [code]simcall_header_t[/code] in bytes (24). Use this as the fixed-size prefix to read before the variable-length payload.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Replaces the payload and updates the header's [code]data_len[/code] to match.

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns the current payload bytes (excluding the header).

method.name: to_string_robust
method.description: Returns the sectioned, byte-offset-labeled debug dump regardless of the [member robust] flag. Decodes the header (including [code]pid[/code]) and interprets the data section by command type: [code]CMD_SYNCH[/code] as group registration, [code]CMD_ACTION[/code] as dev_id + payload, [code]CMD_PROC_HELLO[/code] as the process comm name.

members.member: When [code]true[/code], converting the packet to a string (e.g. [code]print(pkt)[/code]) emits the verbose [method to_string_robust] dump instead of the compact one-line form.

constants.constant: Time-seeding / device-registration command. Payload is the concatenated group bodies; no per-device handshake (D050).
Peripheral I/O command. Payload is a type-sized dev_id followed by the action payload. Reply must echo [code]pid[/code].
Reverse-channel engine → kernel async event (IRQ, V4L2 frame). Emitted by [EventClient]; [code]pid[/code] is 0.
Process announce: sent once per [code]pid[/code] before its first CMD_ACTION. No dev_id; payload is a 16-byte NUL-padded [code]current->comm[/code] name. No reply expected.
